distance.published_absolute_cost_ambiguity: CCS-2012 states only that transpositions are twenty times cheaper; WPES-2013 Table 1 records the reviewed Cai-code costs used here

clean_room_exact_route: compute restricted weighted OSA in compiled native code with three rolling rows
hash each ordered trace and persist one symmetric distance matrix per defense
slice the cached matrix for every temporal and historical fold
compute only the four cross-defense undefended-train to defended-validation/test rectangles
validate native outputs against small exhaustive clean-room cases and the isolated pinned artifact on its common sign-only domain
notes: The 1,500-sample cohort contains 500 traces per defense.
Three full within-defense upper triangles require 375,750 distances; the four non-duplicate temporal validation/test transfer rectangles require another 80,000.
The primary follow-up computed one full matrix once and sliced it for all ten folds.
The linear-time Fast Levenshtein-like metric is a different attack and must not replace DLSVM in a faithful comparison.

compiler_runtime: MPI C++ compiler and mpirun with at least one worker rank
LIBSVM precomputed-kernel train and predict binaries
Python 2 compatibility for the hosted Ca-OSAD.py wrapper

hosted_variant.distance: LEV_METHOD=1 uses restricted OSA with insertion/deletion/substitution 2 and adjacent transposition 0.1
hosted_variant.preprocessing: clLev.cpp converts every nonzero input length to its sign and caps each trace at 5000 observations

non_equivalences_to_ccs_2012: sign-only hosted input versus the CCS-2012 default signed packet-size representation
hosted sentinel and 5000-observation cap are not specified by CCS-2012
run_order: compile and run clLev.cpp with LEV_METHOD=1 to generate pairwise distances
compile and run clgen_stratify.cpp to generate ten precomputed-kernel folds
run Ca-OSAD.py with the matching options and LIBSVM binaries

performance_context.official_repository_warning: the hosted backend recommends more than 100 cores even for a relatively small data set

wpes_2013.scope: 100 sites by 40 instances; combined OSAD and Fast-Levenshtein comparison, not a timing band for Cai OSAD or QCSD

qcsd_adaptation_limits: QUIC ACK frames are encrypted, so the TCP/Tor fixed-size ACK filters cannot be reproduced from the observer trace.
QCSD signed Ethernet frame lengths are an explicit observer-layer adaptation, not the CCS-2012 TCP/Tor packet representation.
Five-class QUIC accuracy is not an absolute reproduction of the 100-site CCS-2012 or 120/200-site CS-BuFLO experiments.
Published attack percentages are contextual reference points only unless protocol, site count, preprocessing, split, code variant, and kernel parameters all match.
validation_gates: Do not accept a DLSVM result produced with unit insertion/deletion/substitution and transposition 0.05 at gamma 1 as author-code-equivalent.
Do not accept the hosted follow-up backend as CCS-2012-equivalent without overriding and recording preprocessing, gamma, and C differences.
Do not start a formal exact run until a measured trace-length census and pair-throughput benchmark demonstrate bounded completion time.
Record trace hashes, distance-engine hash, parameter tuple, matrix hash, fold indices, LIBSVM version, and predictions in the evaluation receipt.
